description: Discover subdomains associated with a domain, as found across mobile applications indexed by BeVigil. Useful for attack surface mapping and asset discovery. Returns a list of unique subdomains. Note: Results come from mobile app analysis, not traditional DNS enumeration.

domain.description: A domain name to discover subdomains for (e.g. "example.com", "target.org"). Do not include protocol (http/https) or paths.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: Number of results to skip before returning a page (default 0). Use this to retrieve results beyond the first page.

name: bevigil_get_subdomains
